Senior Analyst, Quality Control Microbiology Job Description The Senior Analyst, Quality Control Microbiology plays a key role in ensuring the quality and safety of advanced cell and gene therapy products by performing and reviewing a wide range of microbiological quality control activities in a cGMP-regulated environment. This position supports environmental monitoring, clean utility testing, microbiological qualification, and method and equipment qualification while contributing to a culture of integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The role is ideal for a hands-on QC professional who thrives in a dynamic, mission-driven setting and is passionate about work that directly impacts patients’ lives. Apply and advance Operational Excellence and LEAN principles within the QC laboratories to drive continuous improvement across programs, processes, and systems. Prepare, ship, and track samples to external testing laboratories, ensuring proper documentation, chain of custody, and timely delivery. Support on-the-floor GMP activities by executing laboratory work in compliance with cGMP and GDP requirements, including proper documentation and adherence to standard operating procedures. Perform organism qualification, media qualification, and high-throughput environmental monitoring work to support robust microbiological control programs. Shepherd document changes through the document management system, including drafting, revising, and coordinating approvals for QC procedures and related documents. Job Title: Sr Mechanical Analyst – Structural and Thermal Analysis! Job Description This role provides technical leadership in mechanical analysis for complex electronic systems across a broad portfolio of aerospace, defense, intelligence, cyber, and space programs. You will perform high-quality structural and thermal analyses, guide design optimization, and support both local and remote programs. The position offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and contribute directly to mission-critical systems that support national security and public safety. Responsibilities Provide technical leadership and deliver high-quality mechanical analysis support to locally based programs as well as other programs across the broader electronic systems portfolio, including remote support as needed. Plan, coordinate, and execute analysis activities in collaboration with program engineers and program leadership, ensuring alignment with technical requirements, schedules, and program objectives. Perform structural analyses using both classical hand-calculation methods and finite element methods to evaluate modal response, random vibration, shock, and static structural performance. Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, optical, and other engineering disciplines to optimize system designs and ensure robust, integrated solutions across the full product portfolio. Document analysis methods, assumptions, models, results, and conclusions in clear, professional reports and presentations suitable for internal and external stakeholders. Present analysis findings, design recommendations, and risk assessments to internal teams and external customers in a clear and concise manner. Mentor and coach less experienced engineers and part-time analysts, providing technical guidance, feedback, and support to help develop their skills. Review analysis work products from other team members to ensure technical accuracy, completeness, and adherence to standards and best practices. Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive team culture by communicating effectively, maintaining a positive attitude, and supporting cross-functional teamwork.
